messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Been coughing my lungs out for a week now = ( Hopefully I get better soon enough because Chinese New Year is coming and I am craving to eat mandarin oranges!!!

output.original_text: Been coughing my lungs out for a week now = ( Hopefully I get better soon enough because Chinese New Year is coming and I am craving to eat mandarin oranges!!!
output.joy: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, but I can’t wait to get better in time for Chinese New Year because I’m so excited to enjoy those mandarin oranges!!!
output.sadness: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, and it makes me sad to think I might miss out on the mandarin oranges during Chinese New Year.
output.fear: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, and I’m really worried that I won’t recover in time for Chinese New Year and miss out on the mandarin oranges!
output.anger: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, and it’s so frustrating because Chinese New Year is coming, and I just want to eat those mandarin oranges!
output.surprise: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, and I can’t believe it’s almost Chinese New Year, yet I’m not able to eat those mandarin oranges!
output.disgust: I’ve been coughing my lungs out for a week now, and it’s just so irritating because all I want is to savor those juicy mandarin oranges for Chinese New Year!
